description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class 'JavaLanguageGenerator' that generates Java code for Playwright test scripts, including header, footer, and action code snippets, based on different modes ('library' or 'junit'). It also includes utility functions for formatting code components.

classes.name: JavaLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Java code snippets for Playwright automation scripts, supporting 'library' and 'junit' modes, with methods to generate action code, headers, and footers.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Java code for a specific action in the context, such as click, fill, navigate, etc.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates Java code for a specific action call based on the action type.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Produces the Java code header for the test script, including imports and setup, depending on the mode.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Produces the Java code footer, including storage state saving if specified.
